30261784.text: And soon, you'll also begin your journey anew, and depart from Sumeru.

30261785.text: I'm very interested in your future. It's a journey that can't be observed or recorded by this world...

30261786.text: If fate is the ultimate knowledge, then your future will be the ultimate fate.

30261787.text: Paimon's sure glad we got to meet you, Nahida.

30261788.text: The pleasure is all mine... I can't thank you enough.

30261789.text: All right, that's enough talk for today. If you ever miss me, just close your eyes — and maybe I'll appear in your dreams~

30261762.text: According to the records I was able to access, your sibling suddenly appeared in Khaenri'ah...

30261763.text: #After the Khaenri'ah disaster, {M#she}{F#he} began {M#her}{F#his} journey through the seven nations of Teyvat.

30261764.text: #But just as {M#her}{F#his} journey was about to reach its conclusion, the Irminsul records on {M#her}{F#him} suddenly become fuzzy...

30261765.text: #What do you mean, "fuzzy"? Did something happen to {M#her}{F#him}?

30261766.text: #All I know for sure is that somebody, for reasons only they can know, is deliberately obfuscating {F#his}{M#her} fate...

30261767.text: And whoever it is... if they can do that, who knows what else they're capable of.

30261768.text: Could it be related to... the Abyss?

30261769.text: #But even that wouldn't explain how {F#he}{M#she} somehow comes from this world...

30261770.text: Something else I noticed was that according to these records, the Fatui have not classified your sibling as one of the "Descenders."

30261772.text: ...What's a Descender? Paimon's never heard of it...

30261773.text: Look, I'm sure you must be curious about the information I received from the Fatui in return for my Gnosis, right?

30261774.text: A very important part of the intel was about this world's Descenders... external beings, ones that don't belong to this world.

30261777.text: #Huh!? So the Fatui count three other Descenders before {NICKNAME}? And {M#his sister}{F#her brother} isn't even one of them?

30261778.text: That's right. My current hypothesis is that the "First Descender" was likely what we now call the Heavenly Principles.

30261779.text: As for the other Descenders... I still need to verify their existence. It could take me some time.

30261780.text: Whew... Paimon's head's about to burst from all this crazy new information...

30261781.text: And yet, even knowing all this, I'm sure you must still have a lot of unanswered questions. I must say, I truly regret that I can't help you more as the God of Wisdom...

30261782.text: There are many questions in my heart as well. I will need some time to go through each one of them.

30261783.text: Same here... I'll need some time to reflect on what you've said.

30261705.text: Is there anything you want to know?

30261707.text: After recent events, the Akasha can no longer function as it used to.

30261708.text: I've given it some thought, and have decided to shut it down permanently.

30261709.text: But this is definitely not a bad thing. Even from the beginning, I've been planning to shut it down.

30261710.text: The Akasha's centralized administration of knowledge has always restrained people's curiosity and curtailed the number of paths available to them. I don't think this is good for Sumeru.

30261711.text: Although people may initially feel a little uncomfortable with the loss of the Akasha, they will soon understand that this life is more suitable for them.

30261712.text: And as for the future of Sumeru... I'm preparing to regain control of the Akademiya.

30261713.text: The former sages have received their punishment, but the new sages have yet to be selected. I will oversee the process personally.

30261714.text: I hope that the new Six Great Sages will be more focused on academics. Sumeru needs such leaders more than ever.

30261715.text: The other big issue is the people of King Deshret — all the residents of the desert, in fact. They have been mistreated for far too long.

30261716.text: I've already taken some measures to address this. It will take some time to rebuild everything, but no matter if it's culture, friendship, or trust... we will rebuild it.

30261718.text: You mean, what happened after The Doctor put you to sleep?

30261720.text: You guessed correctly... The top-ranked Fatui Harbingers, up to No. 3, possess power comparable to that of gods. I was no match for him in that kind of situation.

30261721.text: However, in spite of the bad situation, I still managed to make a fair deal with The Doctor.

30261722.text: I'm sure you remember the entity that changed your fate — the Heavenly Principles.

30261723.text: In fact, the Heavenly Principles has been quiet since the Khaenri'ah disaster five hundred years ago. I used this point as leverage against The Doctor.

30261724.text: I told him that the Heavenly Principles may be awakened if I destroyed a Gnosis. Although it was just a bluff, he still fell for it.

30261725.text: I assumed that the Heavenly Principles wouldn't just stand by and let such extensive damage to its "laws" take place.

30261726.text: And as for what I exchanged for the Gnoses...

30261727.text: The exchange served as both punishment for The Doctor, as well as a boon of new knowledge that I couldn't refuse as the God of Wisdom.

30261730.text: He's still in a coma. I've hidden him like how one would hide a feather.

30261731.text: I know you have many misgivings about him, but as someone who had "become a god," he has retained a number of very useful features.

30261732.text: Don't worry, I'll keep an eye on him and make sure he doesn't do any evil.

30261733.text: In addition, there are still some mysteries left in him. Some things may be very clear from my perspective, but he has still yet to understand them himself.

30261734.text: His future will be determined by fate.

30261736.text: Is that where you're headed next? Fontaine, the nation of justice.

30261737.text: As far as I know, that nation operates on a judicial system.

30261738.text: Does their archon personally judge people?

30261739.text: No, there's a Chief Justice in Fontaine. Generally speaking, the Hydro Archon, Focalors, won't preside over individual trials.

30261740.text: However... even then, Focalors will still make herself present at just about every trial. It seems that she just likes to immerse herself in that sort of atmosphere.

30261741.text: As archon, she still reserves the right to influence the final verdict.

30261742.text: Anyway, let's just say she's got... hmm... a very unique personality.
